notes.title: Updates and Bug fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing BlazBlue: Continuum Shift Extend!
We have fixed the following issues in this current patch, as follows:

[Patch details]
- Implemented a new feature to allow users to toggle voice chat settings.
- Allow players to view their opponents connection speed status in online mode.
- Fixed the display of special characters and/or other languages in the player's names.
*In the event where a special character is deemed to be invalid, an icon will be displayed instead.
